Company Description

People create momentum. Technology changes the world. We engineer the intelligence that makes it possible. We're Nagarro, a global AI-native engineering and transformation company. We build products and experiences that inspire, excite, and delight. Intelligence isn't something we adopt. It's something we engineer, starting with teams small enough that your ideas move, not wait. That's where you come in!

Job Description

As a Senior Cloud Architect, you will partner with business-focused development teams to design and lead cloud solutions, primarily within AWS, in a complex enterprise environment. You will define and drive cloud architecture strategies that support digital transformation, accelerate cloud adoption, and modernize IT, while ensuring high-quality delivery within the R&D Cloud Operations business and supporting pre-sales activities and customer engagement. Acting as a trusted advisor for cloud transformation, you will provide architectural guidance across projects and product teams, defining and reviewing solution architectures, integration patterns, API strategies, security models, and cloud governance standards in alignment with enterprise architecture principles. As a senior technical leader, you will provide architectural direction and mentorship to DevOps engineers, junior cloud architects, and test automation engineers. You will lead architecture reviews, guide technical decisions, assess requirements, and ensure consistent architectural standards across the engineering organization, taking ownership of complex designs and delivering high-quality outcomes with minimal guidance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create, maintain, and deliver the Cloud Architecture and Solutions
    • Creation and Implementation of Cloud Infrastructure: As a Cloud Infrastructure Architect, you will design and implement cutting-edge cloud infrastructure solutions that align with our business goals and requirements.
    • Continuous Optimization: Focus on enhancing the performance, stability, and responsiveness of our existing cloud infrastructure, ensuring it evolves with the latest technologies and practices.
    • Best Practice Cloud Operations: Champion world-class cloud operations services, integrating code of practice and ensuring all competency centers adhere to standard cloud protocols.
    • Service security and vulnerability standards, designing secure services and ensuring adherence across operational functions.
    • Oversee the system architecture from project inception through delivery, creating both high and low-level designs across applications, infrastructure, and networks.
  • Support the technical roadmap
    • Supervise technical architectural and engineering resources within projects, ensuring alignment with our strategic roadmap.
  • Ensure solution and architectural quality
    • Conduct quality reviews on all automation scripts and tools to ensure DevOps best practices
    • Partner with project and program managers to lead solution delivery, providing technical leadership, guidance, and direction to the project team. Act as the primary interface with the business to ensure the successful adoption of solutions.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience within IT domain.
  • You have a university degree, ideally in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Architecture Ownership mindset is expected.
  • You possess comprehensive knowledge of analysis and design methods for software and AWS cloud solutions as well as a solid understanding of various design and architecture patterns to solve complex problems.
  • Proven enterprise architecture, solution architecture, and cloud deployment experience is mandatory.
  • You have proven in-depth experience in creating and implementing cloud infrastructures with Terraform for IAC.
  • Detailed knowledge of implementing networks and databases, whilst adhering to security policies.
  • You are an expert in AWS services (EKS, EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, IAM..) and their utilization, holding a certification as an AWS Certified Solutions Architect.
  • Linux / Windows OS admin and scripting skills (Bash / Powershell)
  • Experienced in implementing Cloud Security best practices.
  • Significant enterprise architecture definition, solution definition and deployment experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Rest API, API security, OAuth, SSO, microservices and Micro front end architecture and implementation.
  • Experienced in DevOps practices for CI/CD, automation, and configuration management using GitLab, with Jenkins experience considered a plus.
  • Ability to develop and maintain Python and Bash scripts is a must, including automation workflows, AWS Lambda functions, and system integrations.
  • Excellent communication skills in both German and English, with the ability to present to large audiences and explain complex topics clearly.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience with Kubernetes, Helm and Docker, relational and NoSQL databases
  • Practical experience applying AI-assisted engineering tools and MCP-based integrations to improve automation, developer productivity, cloud operations, and solution delivery.
  • Hands-on experience with AI, MCP, Claude Code and/or Github CoPilot.
  • Open shift experience is a plus
  • Experience using, interpreting, and iteratively improving observability platforms
    • CloudWatch and DataDog are strongly preferred here.
  • ArgoCD is a plus

 

  • Service Region: Eastern Europe
